<USER_REQUEST>
Build a responsive web app called "LifeChart" – a patient-friendly lifelong health timeline for India, built as a layer on top of India's ABDM/ABHA ecosystem (not a replacement for it).

POSITIONING
ABDM already provides ABHA IDs and consent-based record exchange. LifeChart adds what it lacks: digitising OLD paper records, a simple Hindi/English timeline, and instant doctor summaries.

USERS
1. Patient: login with ABHA number/address + OTP (demo mode: mock ABHA and mock OTP, with clearly marked integration points for real ABDM APIs later).
2. Doctor: verified via Healthcare Professionals Registry ID (mock for now). Sees a record only after patient consent.
3. Family manager: one account manages parents, children and elderly relatives.

CORE FEATURES
1. Old Records Digitiser (main differentiator): upload photos/PDFs of old prescriptions and reports. OCR extracts doctor, date, diagnosis, medicines, dose, duration. User reviews and confirms the extracted data before saving.
2. Lifelong Health Timeline: birth to today, filterable by year, condition, doctor. Shows illness, treatment given, dose, days to recover.
3. ABDM Sync: "Fetch my ABDM records" button that merges government-linked records into the same timeline (mock data for now).
4. Doctor Quick Summary (one screen): allergies, chronic conditions, current medicines, past similar illnesses, and what treatment worked before. Simple, scannable, no clutter.
5. Consent Sharing: patient generates a QR/6-digit code at the clinic. Doctor gets time-limited access (24h), read plus add only. Patient can revoke anytime. Full audit log of who viewed what.
6. Recurring-Illness Alert: "You had a similar condition in 2019 – treated with X for 5 days."
7. Family and Vaccination: child profiles, vaccination schedule tracker, reminders.
8. Emergency Card: QR showing blood group, allergies, emergency contacts, no login needed.
9. Medicine and follow-up reminders.
10. Hindi/English toggle, plus voice input for adding records.

SECURITY
Encryption in transit and at rest, explicit consent for every share, minimal data collection, DPDP Act 2023-aligned. Never store Aadhaar numbers.

UI/UX
Trustworthy medical look (teal and white), large text, mobile-first, elderly-friendly. Pages: Landing, Login, Dashboard, Timeline, Upload and Review, Doctor Summary, Share Access, Family, Emergency Card.

TECH
React + Tailwind frontend, Supabase (PostgreSQL, storage, auth) backend. Start with a fully working frontend using realistic mock data, then add real OCR and ABDM sandbox integration.
</USER_REQUEST>
